mechanics.claim: Quaking stacks are applied by basic attacks on-hit and by Q, W, and R — specifically Shattered Earth (Q), Upheaval (W), and Impale (R), refreshing duration on reapplication, capping at 3 stacks.
mechanics.quote: '''Skarner's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}}, ''{{ai|Shattered Earth|Skarner}}'', ''{{ai|Upheaval|Skarner}}'', and ''{{ai|Impale|Skarner}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Quaking'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times.

mechanics.claim: Basic attacks that are dodged or missed while blinded do not apply Quaking stacks, but blocked attacks still apply them.
mechanics.quote: Basic attacks that are {{tip|dodge|dodged}} by the target or missed while '''Skarner''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}} do not apply stacks of ''Quake''. {{tip|Block|Blocked}} attacks will still apply stacks.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield only blocks Quaking's application from Upheaval and Impale, not from basic attacks or Shattered Earth.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents ''Quaking's'' application from {{ai|Upheaval|Skarner}} and {{ai|Impale|Skarner}} only.
